description: This file defines the DefaultGenderPrefTracker class, which manages user preferences related to default emoji gender settings, including handling randomization and observing preference changes.

classes.name: DefaultGenderPrefTracker
classes.description: Tracks and manages the default emoji gender preference, supporting random selection and observing preference changes.

methods.name: DefaultGenderPrefTracker
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the tracker and subscribes to preference changes.

methods.name: getDefaultGender
methods.description: Returns the current default gender, randomly choosing if the preference is set to 'random'.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the subscription to preference changes.

methods.name: isDisposed
methods.description: Checks if the disposable subscription has been disposed.
